field.name: BoardUpMessage 'show-more' variant
field.purpose: Lets the reader reveal the next page of one board column; the host validates the stage id and raises that column's visible limit (sc5 hiddenCount).

rationale: sc5 gives each column cards (the shown page) and hiddenCount (the rest behind show-more), and s2's boundary pages each column, but sc3's up-messages have no intent that asks for the next page. One additive variant naming only a stage id keeps up-messages id-only and lets the host keep paging state; nothing existing changes.
